title: Video Downloader - XDownloader
summary: Fast video downloader with multi-format support and smart media management.
description:
XDownloader is a complete solution for anyone who wants to download videos, save media files, and store content offline with maximum speed and convenience. Designed for performance, the app combines a high-speed video downloader, an integrated private browser, and an advanced download manager that supports all major video and audio formats.

Whether you're looking to save HD videos, download clips from social networks, store music, or simply manage your media files more efficiently, this app delivers a smooth and powerful experience.
🔥 Why XDownloader Stands Out:

High-speed video downloading optimized for large files and long content.
Full-format compatibility, including MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WMV, MP3, M4A, and many more.
Smart built-in browser that detects downloadable videos automatically as you browse.
HD & Full HD download support, ensuring the best quality available.
Unlimited simultaneous downloads, perfect for users who download frequently.
Background downloading, allowing you to keep working while files are saved.
Flexible storage options: save files to internal memory or SD card.
Private folder protection to secure sensitive videos with an additional layer of privacy.
Fast and stable performance, optimized for both low-end and high-end devices.
Offline video player with smooth playback and no buffering.
Bookmark system: save your favorite websites and access them instantly.
📥 A Complete Download Manager

XDownloader includes a professional-grade download control system with:
Pause / resume / retry functions
Real-time file progress
Error handling for unstable connections
Large-file support (HD movies, long videos, high-resolution clips)
Clean file organization for easier searching
No more losing downloads halfway — everything is managed automatically.

🌐 Built-In Browser with Auto Detection
The app features a powerful internal browser that allows you to:
Browse websites like a standard mobile browser
Detect videos, music, and media files instantly
Tap to download without copying links
Enjoy a smooth, private, and ad-friendly experience
Just open a site → play a video → tap download. As simple as that.

🧭 How to Use
Open the built-in browser from the app’s home screen.
Visit any website containing videos or media files.
Play or preview a video — the app will automatically detect it.
Tap the download button for instant HD downloading.
You can also paste a direct URL if you prefer manual control.

🔐 Privacy & Safety
Your downloads stay on your device.
XDownloader does not track your data and does not upload or share your files.
You stay fully in control.

📌 Important
This application does not support downloading content from sites where downloading is prohibited.
Always respect copyright and user permissions.
Not affiliated with any social media platforms.
Rated 13+.

🚀 Perfect for Users Who Want To:
Download HD videos for offline viewing
Save music and audio files
Manage media files easily
Use a fast and simple browser-based downloader
Store videos privately and securely
Download in multiple formats without limitations
